description: Shared helpers other mods import: the Data Capture switches (capture_settings), where scan_data/ lives (scan_paths), the off-thread file writer (scan_writer, scan_file_lock), the read side of every scan file (scan_data), the orbit figures (target_info), the move / resize / plate geometry of the HUD windows (window_geometry), the Construction Bay stock helpers (construction_stock), which body a station is on (station_bodies) starting the client again once it has closed (relaunch) and a hash of what a mod folder holds (mod_digest). It changes nothing in the game by itself.
